The question's "core REST API module" is `openmrs-module-webservices.rest`, which calls `UserService.getUserByUuid` in production code in five places. Test files also call it and would need updating if the behaviour changed, so I've listed them after the production code.

**Production code, best first:**

1. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs1_8/UserResource1_8.java`: `getByUniqueId` (line 208) backs `/ws/rest/v1/user/{uuid}` and returns null when the user is missing.
2. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/converter/openmrs1_8/UserConverter1_8.java`: `getByUniqueId` (line 35) is the converter used when a user is referenced by UUID in other resource payloads.
3. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/search/openmrs1_9/ProviderSearchHandler1_9.java`: `search` (line 53) looks up a user from the `user` parameter to find their providers.
4. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/resource/openmrs2_0/AlertRecipientResource2_0.java`: `setRecipientProperty` (line 85) resolves the recipient UUID when creating or updating alert recipients.
5. `openmrs-module-webservices.rest/omod/src/main/java/org/openmrs/module/webservices/rest/web/v1_0/controller/openmrs1_8/ChangePasswordController1_8.java`: `changeOthersPassword` (line 69) resolves the target user before changing their password.
